read_inputs: direct pinned WEB Ephesians USFM text and coordinates
neutral WEB reader and exact-coordinate coverage logic

decision_policy.primary_rule: Prefer the largest unit completing one epistolary, periodic, contrastive, metaphorical, paraenetic, household, or closing operation without absorbing the next.

macro_parents.function: Prescript, extended eulogy, thanksgiving, and illumination prayer.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Eph.1.2/1.3 and 1.14/1.15 are functional turns inside one opening parent.

macro_parents.function: Former-death to new-life contrast, former alienation to reconciliation, household, and temple movement.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Eph.2.10/2.11 begins a second former-now sequence without cancelling chapter-wide cohesion.

macro_parents.function: Stewardship and mystery report, intercessory prayer, and doxology.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The resumed for-this-cause at 3.14 closes the suspension begun at 3.1.

macro_parents.function: Unity exhortation and confession followed by gift, citation, and body-growth sequence.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The one-all contrast at 4.7 differentiates movements while preserving the unity/body argument.

macro_parents.function: Old-new walk contrast, concrete paraenesis, imitation/love, darkness-light, and wisdom/Spirit-filled movement.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Cross-chapter continuity at 4.32/5.1 and repeated walk language govern the parent.

macro_parents.function: Mutual-submission transition and full reciprocal household address.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Eph.5.21 may close the Spirit-filled chain or frame the household address; both exact routes remain held.

macro_parents.function: Strength and armor exhortation, all-prayer and mission request, Tychicus notice, and benediction.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Armor, prayer, mission, news, and blessing remain the larger closing parent.

units.literary_rationale: The sender, addressee, and greeting form a compact prescript before the blessing formula.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Atomizing sender and greeting obscures the prescript.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: The addressee wording does not settle audience or circular-letter history.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: One extended blessing unfolds through coordinated predicates and refrains to the pledge and final praise formula.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Clause-level splitting destroys the periodic eulogy.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Eph.1.15 begins thanksgiving on hearing a report.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: The unit does not authorize election, predestination, salvation, cosmology, or church doctrine.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: Thanksgiving supplies the ground for an illumination prayer whose requests culminate in a power and body sequence.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating thanksgiving from prayer removes its stated ground.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No cosmology, rule hierarchy, or ecclesiology is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Former death, divine intervention, grace inference, and workmanship
units.literary_rationale: The former condition, intervention, purpose, grace inference, and workmanship outcome constitute one contrast.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching grace or workmanship erases the contrast and inference.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No anthropology, salvation, grace/works, or moral doctrine is adjudicated.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Former alienation, reconciliation, household, and temple
units.literary_rationale: The former alienation and now-nearness contrast develops through peace and reconciliation to household and temple application.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting metaphors from reconciliation removes their application.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No covenant, law, ethnicity, reconciliation, temple, or ecclesial authority is selected.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Stewardship, mystery report, purpose, and endurance request
units.literary_rationale: The interrupted for-this-cause construction expands into a stewardship report and closes with the request not to lose heart.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Fragmenting the suspension hides its report-and-request function.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No authorship, office, mystery, mission, cosmology, or church doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The resumed prayer carries nested requests through fullness and resolves in a two-verse doxology.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: The doxology is the prayer resolution, not a detachable slogan.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Eph.4.1 begins the therefore walk exhortation.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No family, indwelling, fullness, church, or divine-power doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Worthy walk, peace bond, and one-confession
units.literary_rationale: The worthy-walk appeal specifies unity-preserving dispositions and culminates in the repeated one-confession.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting the confession removes the exhortation rationale.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Eph.4.7 shifts from one/all to each-one gift language.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No baptismal, ecclesial, or doctrinal confession authority is asserted.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Gift, ascent citation, equipping, and body growth
units.literary_rationale: Individual grace, citation and aside, gift list, purposes, and the body-growth outcome form one movement.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Citation, gifts, and body inference are mutually explanatory.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No office hierarchy, gift system, quotation source, cosmology, or ecclesiology is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Former Gentile walk and learned old-new contrast
units.literary_rationale: The negative walk description is answered by the learned-Christ contrast and old/renewed/new clothing sequence.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching the old-new triad removes the contrast answer.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No anthropology, identity, holiness, or ethics doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Truth, anger, labor, speech, forgiveness, imitation, and love walk
units.literary_rationale: Concrete replacements with rationales culminate across the chapter seam in imitation and love-walk application.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: A chapter split severs forgiveness from therefore-imitation.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Eph.5.3 turns to a new prohibited-list and darkness/light sequence.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No speech, labor, anger, forgiveness, imitation, or ethics code is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: Prohibited lists lead into deception warning, former-now light identity, walk/reproof sequence, and awakening citation.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Atomizing lists or citation detaches them from the light-walk frame.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Eph.5.15 begins a therefore careful-walk development.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No vice, inheritance, wrath, light, or ethics doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Wise walk and Spirit-filled participial sequence
units.literary_rationale: The wise-walk contrasts culminate in the filled imperative and its coordinated speaking, singing, and thanksgiving results.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting participles from the filled imperative removes their syntax and function.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Eph.5.21 is a held transition into the household frame.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No wisdom, intoxication, worship, or Spirit-filled practice is prescribed.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Mutual submission and complete reciprocal household address
units.literary_rationale: The transitional participle frames three reciprocal address pairs; each command remains with counterpart and rationale across the chapter seam.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting pairs or counterparts turns rhetoric into isolated rules.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Eph.6.10 finally begins the strength/armor exhortation.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No household, gender, status, slavery, marriage, parenting, or institutional authority is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Strength, whole armor, all-prayer, and mission request
units.literary_rationale: The strength command, armor rationale and catalogue continue syntactically into all-prayer and the personal boldness request.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Armor pieces without prayer and mission become atomized symbols.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No demonology, cosmology, warfare, armor-item, or mission doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The messenger notice states its comfort purpose and is followed by coordinated peace-love and grace wishes completing the letter.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching news from blessing fragments the epistolary close.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: No following received Ephesians coordinate exists.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No messenger history, audience, canon, or benediction doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

global_premortems.mitigation: Retain the complete eulogy and exact smaller alternatives.

global_premortems.detection: Thanksgiving or stewardship is severed from prayer.
global_premortems.mitigation: Bind prayers to grounds and doxological resolution.

global_premortems.detection: Former state is detached from intervention or inference.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain both Eph.2 contrasts through their conclusions.

global_premortems.detection: Reconciliation is detached from household/temple application.
Confession, citation, gifts, or body growth becomes a standalone proof text.
The 4.32/5.1 seam is selected only by chapter.
Paraenetic or armor list members become chunks.
global_premortems.mitigation: Bind every list to command, contrast, rationale, and outcome.

global_premortems.detection: Reciprocal addresses are converted into roles or rules.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain Eph.5.21-6.9 and defer all policy.

global_premortems.detection: Metaphor items are mapped into a warfare system.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain armor with prayer and mission request; authorize nothing.

global_premortems.detection: A seam selects an addressee, witness, reading, punctuation, source, or speaker.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep variant-sensitive seams LOW and preserve alternatives.

global_premortems.detection: Travel notice, prayer request, or benediction is isolated.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain the Eph.6.10-24 larger closing parent.
